description: Orientative first look at which Spanish visa or residence route fits a person, from a few facts: purpose (retire or live on passive income, remote work, study, join family, local job, business), EU citizenship, partner or family in Spain, income and family members. Returns the likely routes with the 2026 income figure and quick checks. It is not legal advice: for a real answer offer personal_visa_assessment (emailed by the firm's lawyer) or request_consultation.

currently_in_spain_legally.description: True if the user is in Spain now with a legal stay (for example within their 90 Schengen days).

family_members.description: Family members moving with the user (spouse, children), not counting the user.

is_eu_citizen.description: True if the user holds an EU, EEA or Swiss passport.

monthly_income_eur.description: Monthly income in euros (for remote work: gross, before tax).

partner_or_family_in_spain.description: If the user is joining a partner or family member who is Spanish, another EU citizen, or a non-EU resident of Spain.

purpose.description: Main reason for moving to Spain.

name: which_spain_visa
title: Which Spain visa fits me?
